title: Pain
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask an open question first and let the patient describe the pain in their own words before offering any options.
Ask what the patient can no longer do, because that is the answer that will define whether treatment worked.
Avoid offering a list of descriptors to choose from.
Pain that does not fit any pattern on this chapter's pages should prompt a search above and below the knee before a scan of the knee.
A patient told they have arthritis describes arthritic pain, which is why the history should precede the notes and the images.
